name: context-core
description: Lightweight shared-context runtime for approved handoffs, evidence, recall, and coordinated writes.

interface.shortDescription: Resume work and preserve reusable evidence safely.
interface.longDescription: Stores approved session handoffs and non-authoritative observations as Markdown, narrows recall through deterministic semantic indexes, and acts as the only physical writer for context-common/v1 artifact owners.
defaultPrompt: Use $context-core:context for one scoped index-first recall when prior handoff, evidence, or decisions may change the work.
Use $context-core:init only when the user asks to initialize the repository context root or its auto-loaded policy block.
Finish the primary task first, audit at most once per semantic milestone, and write only an exact approved final bundle through the context-core coordinator.
